newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai air cargo traffic rise 14 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dubai air cargo traffic rise 14 pct in 1996.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose 14 percent in 1996 to a record 358,982 tonnes from 315,809 in 1995.

Exports rose 10 percent to 170,416 tonnes and imports increased by 17 percent to 188,566 tonnes. Of the total, transhipments amounted to 61,134 tonnes, a 23 percent gain. The figures include transit goods, but do not include courier and mail items.
The highest volume of exports handled on a single day was 730.29 tonnes on December 18. The highest imports handled in one day was 740.01 tonnes on December 23.
With the last nine months of the year registering year-on-year drops in sea-air shipments, total sea-air freight handled in the year fell by some four percent to 64,814 tonnes.
Courier and mail totalled 10,288 tonnes in the year, up nearly four percent.
The cargo village said volumes for the month of December were up almost 15 percent to 33,510 tonnes. Of this, exports made up 15,551 tonnes and imports 17,958.

Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates. Its airport is the busiest in the Gulf. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
